description: This file implements polymorphic helpers for managing and viewing the history of Kubernetes resources such as Deployments, StatefulSets, and DaemonSets, including retrieving revision histories and applying specific revisions.

classes.name: HistoryViewer
classes.description: Interface for resources with historical information, providing methods to view and get history.

classes.name: HistoryVisitor
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation to assign specific history viewers based on resource type.

classes.name: DeploymentHistoryViewer
classes.description: Provides access to the revision history of a Deployment.

classes.name: DaemonSetHistoryViewer
classes.description: Provides access to the revision history of a DaemonSet.

classes.name: StatefulSetHistoryViewer
classes.description: Provides access to the revision history of a StatefulSet.

methods.name: ViewHistory
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource's revision history, optionally for a specific revision.

methods.name: GetHistory
methods.description: Returns a map of revision numbers to resource objects for the resource.

methods.name: printTemplate
methods.description: Formats a PodTemplateSpec into a string for display.

methods.name: printHistory
methods.description: Formats the revision history into a string, showing change causes and revisions.

methods.name: applyDaemonSetHistory
methods.description: Applies a specific ControllerRevision to a DaemonSet to reconstruct a historical version.

methods.name: applyStatefulSetHistory
methods.description: Applies a specific ControllerRevision to a StatefulSet to reconstruct a historical version.

methods.name: controlledHistoryV1
methods.description: Retrieves ControllerRevisions owned by a specific object, for controllers like StatefulSet.

methods.name: controlledHistory
methods.description: Retrieves ControllerRevisions owned by a specific object, for controllers like Deployment.

methods.name: daemonSetHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the DaemonSet and its ControllerRevisions.

methods.name: statefulSetHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the StatefulSet and its ControllerRevisions.

methods.name: tabbedString
methods.description: Helper to format output in tabular form.

methods.name: getChangeCause
methods.description: Extracts the change cause annotation from a runtime.Object.
